title: Persistent mode switch that re-skins the page
summary: Docked segmented switch + Grid overlay pill + `L` / `D` / `G` hotkeys (ignored in text fields and with Ctrl / Alt / Meta), state set as root attributes, stored in `localStorage`, printed in the label and restored by a head script before first paint; at the close the dock cross-scales out (`1.75`) as a large centred copy arrives (from `.5`), one copy reachable at a time; no tween under reduced motion
variants: segmented theme switch + grid overlay pill + L / D / G hotkeys, docked switch handing off to a large centred copy at the close (this, default)
three-way light / dark / system: store 'system' and follow prefers-color-scheme while it is chosen
alternate-world mode: the same stored root attribute swaps a whole second register (ground, display face, decorative layer)
